title: An mRNA-lipid nanoparticle vaccine against H5N1 influenza virus protects lactating dairy cows from infection.

title: Single-cell analysis reveals favorable responses of tumor-associated monocytes to bortezomib-based treatment in multiple myeloma.
snippet: The bone marrow microenvironment (BME) has a significant effect on bortezomib (BTZ)-based chemotherapy in patients with multiple myeloma (MM).
